SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
C.S.6, Special Branch
REPORT
Date July 16, 1941

Subject (in full) P.H. TOLANI - arrival of.

Made by D.S.I. Wittinsky Forwarded by D.S.I. Wilcox

Panlajrai Hiranand Tolani alias Panlaj, British
Indian, age 30, manager of the Commercial Agency, 72
Hongkong Road, who was suspected of having misappropriated
the sum of $182,000 (see F.I.R. 749/41 C.), arrived in
Shanghai from Nagasaki, on the 2-7-41, aboard the s.s.
"Nagasaki Maru".
On the passenger manifest his profession is
given as merchant and his address 146 Quinsan Road.

2.6 (CWSB)

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH）

A.C. (Special Branch).

O. Wittinsky
D. S. I.

报告
日期：1941年7月16日

主题（全称）P.H. TOLANI - 抵达情况。

由特别股督察 Wittinsky 撰写，由特别股督察 Wilcox 转呈

Panlajrai Hiranand Tolani，别名 Panlaj，英属印度人，30岁，香港路72号商业代理行经理，涉嫌挪用公款182,000元（见刑事案件初报 749/41 C.），于1941年7月2日乘坐“长崎丸”号轮船从长崎抵达上海。

在乘客名单上，其职业登记为商人，地址为昆山路146号。

2.6 (CWSB)

（印：特别股）

助理总监（特别股）。

O. Wittinsky
特别股督察

（印：归档）
